# package loading
```{r}
# install.packages("openalexR")
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(
  openalexR, cowplot, tidyverse, httr, jsonlite,
  citecorp, rcrossref, purrr, dplyr, tibble, fect, furrr, future, data.table,
  panelView, rscopus, httr2
)

source("R/api_cache.R")
```
# load dataset
```{r}
abstracts_already <- readRDS("data/abstracts.csv")
df_meta <- readRDS("data/metadata_OpenAlex.rds")
# remove spaces from dois
df$doi_o <- gsub(" ", "", df$doi_o)
df$doi_r <- gsub(" ", "", df$doi_r)
```

#already existing abstracts
```{r}
abstract_df <- df_meta %>%
  select(doi_o, abstract, title) %>%
  left_join(
    abstracts_already %>% select(doi_o, abstract_fill = abstract),
    by = "doi_o"
  ) %>%
  mutate(abstract = coalesce(abstract, abstract_fill)) %>%
  select(-abstract_fill)

abstract_df <- unique(abstract_df)
```
# getting metadata for the original studies
```{r}
# get dois for studies without abstracts
dois_abstract <- abstract_df %>%
  filter(is.na(abstract)) %>%
  select(doi_o)
dois_abstract <- unique(dois_abstract$doi_o)
email <- Sys.getenv("MY_EMAIL")
## add email address to run!
options(openalexR.mailto = email)
# fetch metadata
OA_abstract <- cached_oa_fetch(
  entity = "works",
  doi = dois_abstract,
  output = "tibble",
  cache_key = list(stage = "abstract_backfill_openalex"),
  verbose = TRUE
)


abstract_df <- abstract_df %>%
  left_join(
    OA_abstract %>%
      mutate(doi_o = str_remove(doi, "https://doi.org/")) %>% # strip the prefix
      select(doi_o, title_new = title, abstract_new = abstract), # rename to avoid column clash
    by = "doi_o"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abstract = coalesce(abstract, abstract_new),
    title = coalesce(title, title_new) # fill NAs in abstract and title with newly collected ones
  ) %>%
  select(-abstract_new) # drop the helper column
```

#abstracts
```{r}
Skey <- Sys.getenv("SCOPUS_API_KEY")
dois_sansAbs <- abstract_df %>%
  filter(is.na(abstract)) %>%
  select(doi_o)
dois_sansAbs <- unique(dois_sansAbs$doi_o)

extraAbs <- purrr::map(
  dois_sansAbs,
  ~ cached_abstract_retrieval(
    id         = .x, # the DOI itself
    identifier = "doi", # tell rscopus it's a DOI
    api_key    = Skey
  )
)

contents <- lapply(extraAbs, function(x) x$content)
abstracts_sc <- contents %>%
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null") %>%
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble()

# combine abstracts from both sources into one file

abstracts_sc$`abstracts-retrieval-response.item.bibrecord.head.abstracts`
abstracts_sc$`abstracts-retrieval-response.item.bibrecord.item-info.itemidlist.ce:doi`


clean_abs <- abstracts_sc %>%
  transmute(
    doi_o = `abstracts-retrieval-response.item.bibrecord.item-info.itemidlist.ce:doi`,
    abstract_filled = `abstracts-retrieval-response.item.bibrecord.head.abstracts`,
    title_filled = `abstracts-retrieval-response.item.bibrecord.head.citation-title`
  )

abstract_df <- abstract_df %>%
  left_join(
    clean_abs %>%
      select(doi_o, abstract_filled, title_filled),
    by = "doi_o"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abstract = coalesce(abstract, abstract_filled),
    title = coalesce(title, title_filled) # fill NAs in title and abstract with newly collected ones
  ) %>%
  select(-abstract_filled, -title_filled, -title_new)

abstract_df %>%
  filter(is.na(abstract)) %>% View()

write.csv(abstract_df, "data/abstracts.csv")
```
